name: Automated Testing Kit Demonstration
description: Set up demonstration of Automated Testing Kit.
project_description: Submodule of Automated Testing Kit that scaffolds a runnable demonstration test project. Its RecipeEventSubscriber reacts to the 'Automated Testing Kit - Demonstration Recipe' being applied: it runs the module_support/atk_setup script to copy Playwright tests and config into the project root, rewrites the Drush alias and baseURL in the generated config to match the current DDEV site, and runs cron to index the site. Its install hook also runs cron. Developer/CI tooling for local/QA use only.
